changes: Lottie artwork now uses centered uniform aspect fitting, fixing stretched recommendation art across game-over, menu and village cards.
Santa Selfie and its action icons now retain premultiplied alpha from image decoding through filtering and drawing; spray source-atop and decoration source-over blending updated consistently.
Village/card Lottie playback no longer drops fractional frame changes below half a source frame.
Selfie reuses its beard surface only when the complete visible point state and target size are identical; solver constraint iteration no longer clones lists.
Added opt-in live frame profiler; does not measure input-to-photon latency or change simulation steps.
remaining: Six native scenes remain partial; 49 source scenes have no native implementation.
Other modes still need individual edge/capture checks. Existing shared edge bleed and opaque target copy remain active.
Whole-site smoothness and minimum input latency are not verified; presentation stalls contaminated post-change desktop profiles.
Cold village image/Lottie parsing and first-use Ogg decode still run on the main thread.
The overlay artwork aspect is corrected; full overlay typography/layout is not certified 1:1.
